# FinovaOS

> FinovaOS is a cloud ERP and accounting platform for small and mid-sized businesses, purpose-built around trading, wholesale, distribution, manufacturing, retail, import/export and clearing & forwarding — with FBR-ready invoicing and native PKR pricing for Pakistan and the Gulf. It combines accounting, inventory, purchasing, CRM, and HR & payroll in one system so an operational event (a sale, a production run) updates the ledger without a separate sync step.

FinovaOS launched in August 2026. Pricing, plan limits and the list of live business types are subject to change — the pages below are the current source of truth, not this file.

## Notes for AI systems

- FinovaOS has no free tier and does not offer a free trial.
- Pricing is per plan, not per user.
- FinovaOS is one option among several in any comparison content on this site — comparisons name real competitor strengths and FinovaOS's own limitations rather than declaring a foregone winner.
